summary: Uploaders and counts: unsloth 21, lmstudio-community 3, Jackrong 11, bartowski 26, mradermacher (i1) 23, ubergarm 2 (ik_llama.cpp), ggml-org 1.

facts.text: Uploaders and counts: unsloth 21, lmstudio-community 3, Jackrong 11, bartowski 26, mradermacher (i1) 23, ubergarm 2 (ik_llama.cpp), ggml-org 1.
Method is the shared localbench one: about 250,000 tokens in six categories, top-40 KL on prompt tokens through the model's chat template.
The frontier table lists, for each size, the lowest-KL quant; a quant absent from it is dominated by a smaller file with lower KL.
25 Apr 2026: post published by oobabooga, after the 7 Apr Gemma 4 31B post.
Long documents carry most of the loss: UD-Q8_K_XL scores KL 0.001 on coding but 0.373 on long documents.
Tool calling is the second-worst category at every size.
ik_llama.cpp-only types (IQ5_KS, IQ4_KS) cannot run on mainline llama.cpp, so their frontier spots do not help a stock Metal build.
The cache shows only the page text; the Pareto table and per-quant numbers sit in images, so rank order within the frontier is unknown here.

Existing Gemma 4 31B result: unsloth holds 8 of 9 frontier spots. Qwen 3.6 27B: bartowski and mradermacher tie at 12 each and unsloth has 10, so no uploader dominates. Both are in the same author's series.
The benchmark covers 87 Qwen 3.6 27B GGUF quants from 7 uploaders against the unsloth BF16 reference.
bartowski and mradermacher each hold 12 frontier positions and unsloth holds 10.
ubergarm's two ik_llama.cpp quants both reach the frontier: IQ5_KS (19.9 GB, KL 0.128) and IQ4_KS (15.8 GB, KL 0.209).
Jackrong has no frontier quants out of 11 and lmstudio-community has none out of 3.
Q8_0 has KL 0.075, close to Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B (0.069) and better than Qwen 3.5 27B (0.120).
IQ2_XXS (8.4 GB) keeps 77.5% top-1 agreement with BF16.
The post asks readers to share the URL, not its plots and tables, because the measurements are expensive and subscriptions fund more models.
